question.worked_solution:
First, notice that the numbers $64$ and $27$ are both perfect cubes. 

So, to determine the value of $\sqrt[3]{\frac{64}{27}},$ we express $\frac{64}{27}$ as a perfect cube:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[3]{\frac{64}{27}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{{4}^{3}}{{3}^{3}}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{4\cdot 4\cdot 4}{3\cdot 3\cdot 3}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{4}{3}\cdot \frac{4}{3}\cdot \frac{4}{3}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{{(\frac{4}{3})}^{3}} & = \\ \frac{4}{3} & \end{aligned}
$$
